verdict.rationale: Caveman's core pieces run on the user's own machine: the open-source CLI, the response-shortening skill, and a local proxy for context compression all work without a Cloud account. The evidence does not show self-hosting the rest of the product, such as Cloud computers, billing, guardrails, budgets and audit, which appear to be hosted by the vendor. missing for 10: documented self-hosting or deployment guide, a self-hostable option for the Cloud/team features, independent hands-on confirmation of running fully self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The open-source CLI, shorter replies and context compression work without one.
a local proxy shrinks the logs, JSON and diffs it reads.
